prompts.homePrompt: Create eight NEW furniture sprites for Ouzana, a Brazilian botanist living in a small house with a home laboratory. Match the reference game's topview 2D RPG projection, deliberate square pixel clusters, dark outlines, warm natural wood, cream, sage and olive green. Reference is STYLE ONLY, do not reuse its blue couch or rug. Exactly 8 isolated complete objects in 4 columns x 2 rows, transparent RGBA, landscape 1536x1024. Same logical pixel density across objects, generous transparent margins, no drawn cell borders, labels, ground, shadows, glow, blurring or antialiasing. Camera sees front faces plus top surfaces as in a topview RPG, never isometric. Reading order: 0 warm wooden single bed with sage-green quilt, cream pillow and modest vine-carved headboard; 1 compact wood herbarium bookshelf with books, specimen folders and glass seed jars; 2 two-seat sage-green sofa with wooden arms and a cushion featuring simple fern pixels, facing the viewer; 3 low rattan and wood coffee table with one closed botanical book and one tiny succulent; 4 small wood and sage-green kitchenette cabinet, ceramic sink and drying herbs; 5 lush fern and monstera in a terracotta pot; 6 wall hanging rack of dried herbs with a small trailing plant; 7 house window in warm wooden frame with a planter full of ferns on the sill. Complete furniture, not scene composition. Crisp unsmoothed solid pixel silhouettes, realistic usable proportions relative to each other, no mist or soft halo. Logical width roughly 40-72 pixels per object enlarged in whole square pixels. Keep at least 32 transparent pixels between sprites and cell edges.
